# Changelog

## 0.3.0 Beta - 2026-11-11

- Added LG and LG2 28-bit protocol probes to the existing setup wizard, tried sequentially.
- Added direct LG/LG2 power, temperature, Heat/Cool mode and fan control through the unchanged main screen.
- Added LG profile decoding and control-state recovery when loading saved units.
- Confirmed an LG protocol works on one physical unit; wider model coverage remains experimental.
- Documented unresolved compatibility with some older Gree units and other model-dependent limitations.
- Prepared the public beta release on GitHub.

## 0.2

- Added a manufacturer-based setup wizard with ordered protocol trials and Yes/No confirmation.
- Bundled Mitsubishi Electric, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Gree and Fujitsu protocol families.
- Added unit profile selection, naming and deletion.
- Added direct temperature, mode, fan and power control for supported decoded protocols.
- Refreshed the application name and icon as A/C Master.
